en.headline: 9 commits in sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu: AI diagnosis, CI fix, pagination fix
en.summary: In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, **9 own commits** plus **16 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` were made. Key changes: added AI all-failure auto-diagnosis with an `/oc` manual recheck entry; fixed `opencode.yml` `if` using `toLower` (unavailable in GitHub expressions); fixed `check.yml` `summary` window assertion no longer hard-comparing "today now" (midnight red-run root cause); fixed event pagination treating HTTP `422` as fatal (now using `Link` header); refreshed codemap to `46667bc` and `4719825`; plus temporary acceptance tests (non-existent `model id` to induce failures, non-existent `/oc` `login` account to test skip) then reverted. Opened or closed **5 issues**, all on issue `9` (`[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`): 1 open, 3 comments, 1 close. Received 3 replies: `yulia-ivashko` closed `openchamber/openchamber` issues `4899` (browser capture resolution bug) and `4111` (orphaned MCP child processes); `github-actions[bot]` posted 2 automated replies on issue `9` (AI diagnosis result and a `pong` with a run link).

zh.headline: sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 仓库 9 次提交：AI 诊断、CI 修复、分页修复
zh.summary: 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库完成了 **9 次本人提交**，另有 **16 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。主要变更包括：新增 AI 全失败自动诊断功能及 `/oc` 手动补查入口；修复 `opencode.yml` 中 `if` 条件误用 `toLower`（GitHub 表达式不支持该函数）；修正 `check.yml` 中 `summary` 窗口断言不再与「此刻的今天」硬比（解决半夜必红的根因）；修复事件分页将 HTTP `422` 误判为致命错误（改以 `Link` 头为准）；刷新 codemap 映射基线到 `46667bc` 和 `4719825`；以及一系列临时验收测试（将 `model id` 改为不存在的值制造真失败、将 `/oc` 的 `login` 门改为不存在的账号测试跳过逻辑）并随后回滚。新开或关闭 **5 个 issue**，全部集中在 issue `9`（`[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）`）：1 次打开、3 次评论、1 次关闭。收到 3 条回复：`yulia-ivashko` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue `4899`（浏览器截图分辨率 bug）和 `4111`（多运行删除后残留 MCP 子进程）；`github-actions[bot]` 在 issue `9` 上发布了 2 条自动回复（AI 诊断结果和带有 run 链接的 `pong`）。
